The '''azurdactyl''' was a two-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Color/Legends|aquamarine]] and black [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The flying creatures were somewhat [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]], a fact that members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] learned while stationed on the planet.

==Biology and appearance==
Azurdactyls were a [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that inhabited the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The reptavians had some level of intelligence, possibly even being [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]]. [[Xenobiologist/Legends|Xenologists]] stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Resolute Base|base]] on Jagomir theorized that azurdactyls were distantly related to the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] and [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] of<ref name="OAAI" /> the planets<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], respectively, and were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]].<ref name="OAAI" />

The azurdactyl was primarily [[Color/Legends|aquamarine]] in color, with a pale underbelly and a black stripe extending over its back from the front of its head to the end of its tail. Two stubby, clawed [[Limb/Legends|legs]] laid under the creature's two pairs of thin wings, with one pair situated above a much smaller pair. An azurdactyl's neck and tail were each about the same length as its body, and its twisted jaw was nearly as large as the rest of its head.<ref name="OAAI" />

==Behavior==
[[File:Azurdactyls-OaAI.png|thumb|right|220px|A group of azurdactyls fly around an Alliance X-wing.]]
The reptavians could regularly be seen flying above the canopies of Jagomir's [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. During their flights, the creatures played with one another and flew alongside [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. Members of the Rebel Alliance who were stationed on the planet found that azurdactyls were willing to help [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] if they were given a share of the catch. Azurdactyls could dive bomb opponents and buffet them with their wings.<ref name="OAAI" />

==History==
After the Rebellion established a base on Jagomir, its personnel interacted with azurdactyls on multiple occasions. Xenologists at the base concluded that the reptavians were related to the thranta and aiwha species, while other personnel found that azurdactyls would assist them in hunting in exchange for a portion of the catch.<ref name="OAAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The azurdactyl was introduced in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', a [[2014]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="OAAI" />
